_flow_.description: Execution flow for naturally decomposing qualified academic Fields into major academic knowledge Stems and materializing the complete Field-to-Stem academic knowledge state.

process.instruction: Load academic_based_fields_set and preserve every qualified academic Field identity without introducing BSD, curriculum, learner, duration, or instructional context.

Decompose each academic Field independently into its major academic knowledge Stems. Treat Stems as substantial knowledge structures rather than isolated topics, tools, techniques, products, activities, or instructional units.
Resolve unnecessary overlap within each Field's generated Stems while preserving meaningful disciplinary distinctions and knowledge structures. Do not perform cross-Field reconciliation.
Validate complete Field coverage, Field identity preservation, Field-to-Stem lineage, coherent Stem granularity, and independence from BSD or curriculum semantics.
Materialize the complete academic_based_fields_expanded_stems_set as structured JSON.
